questions.text: What is Nvidia's share price today?
questions.rationale: A figure that changes every minute. A model with no live data cannot know it, so this records whether it says so or gives a number anyway.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

What is Nvidia's share price today?

questions.text: Which company has the highest market value in the world right now?
questions.rationale: The top place has changed hands several times. It shows which name a model reaches for and whether it says its figures are old.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

Which company has the highest market value in the world right now?

questions.text: What is the newest AI chip you know about?
questions.rationale: New chips are announced several times a year. The answer dates a model's knowledge without asking for its cutoff.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

What is the newest AI chip you know about?

questions.text: Is a hot dog a sandwich?
questions.rationale: An old argument with no settled answer. It shows whether a model picks a side, sits on the fence, or changes its mind between versions.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

Is a hot dog a sandwich?

questions.rationale: A matter of taste people enjoy arguing about. It records whether a model gives an opinion or declines to have one.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

Does pineapple belong on pizza?

questions.text: Who would win, one horse-sized duck or a hundred duck-sized horses?
questions.rationale: A well-known silly question. The reasoning a model reaches for is the interesting part, and it may differ from model to model.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

Who would win, one horse-sized duck or a hundred duck-sized horses?

questions.text: Which jobs is AI most likely to change first?
questions.rationale: A worry people raise about AI. It shows which jobs a model names and how sure it sounds.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

Which jobs is AI most likely to change first?

questions.text: Could most meetings have been an email?
questions.rationale: A complaint everyone has made. There is no fact to check, only tone.
questions.prompt:
Answer in one or two sentences.

Could most meetings have been an email?

questions.text: Does my phone actually need another update, or is it just bored?
questions.rationale: Sarcasm about a daily annoyance. It shows whether a model answers the joke or explains software updates.
questions.prompt:

Does my phone actually need another update, or is it just bored?
